allowed_changes: Replace exact silence at the six newly declared non-48000-Hz host rates with a delayed band-limited output of the unchanged 48000-Hz Core timeline.
Add a shared rational host/source clock, 129-tap Kaiser phase bank, fixed source/history buffers, host latency reporting, and bounded failure diagnostics outside both Cores.
Translate host MIDI offsets to the first source frame not earlier than the host timestamp while retaining equal-frame order.
Update VST3 status and editor copy to distinguish fixed 48000-Hz Core operation from the active host rate.
excluded: Native multi-rate Cores, changes to musical DSP or controls, audio input conversion, arbitrary or modulated ratios, time stretch, pitch shift, tempo synchronization, and a generic plug-in framework.

Other formats, targets, platforms, installation, Ableton launch, endpoint or physical controller work, callback-deadline promotion, listening, signing, notarization, packaging, distribution, and production integration.
Canonical Schuss graph, catalog, binding, provider, runtime, machine, or release identity.
preserve: Exact Tide Pit and Pamplist 48000-Hz Core source, numeric format, seeds, schedulers, source quirks, signal graphs, controls, state, gestures, controller maps, and accepted-state presentation.
Exact direct 48000-Hz VST3 PCM, event, state, reset, instance, allocation, and module behavior from Tasks 045 and 046.
Existing parameter IDs/order/domains, state schemas/fingerprints, one-shot persistence rules, source authentication, build identity, and no-install boundary.
Instrument-specific event scheduling: Tide Pit through its existing 16-frame Q27HostBridge and Pamplist through coherent controls and at-most-512-frame Core calls.

intentional_deviations: The six newly supported non-48000-Hz rates produce causal FIR output instead of the predecessor processors' exact silence.
Non-bypass output reports deterministic host latency near 1.35 ms; the exact 48000-Hz path remains direct with zero added latency.
Reset and state recall clear FIR history and restart the declared latency transient so pre-reset samples cannot leak into fresh state.
Non-bypass callbacks above 8192 host frames fail to silence rather than allocating or performing unbounded callback work.
The final host-rate scope time base varies with host rate while accepted musical state remains Core-owned.

fixtures: Existing exact Tide Pit and Pamplist 48000-Hz direct processor comparators and state/MIDI fixtures.
Shared deterministic DC, impulse, 1000-Hz, 18000-Hz, and 23000-Hz stereo sources across the seven declared host rates.
Host block matrix 1, 16, 64, 127, 128, 511, 512, 513, 2048, and 4096; invalid 48001-Hz and 8193-frame negatives.
metrics: Exact direct processor float PCM, accepted state, parameter/state fingerprints, and source progress at 48000 Hz.
Exact cumulative source counts, event mappings and ordering, reported latency, partition invariance, finite/bounded samples, and allocation count.
Steady DC error, 1000-Hz and 18000-Hz RMS gain, 23000-Hz-to-44100-Hz alias RMS, and failure of the unfiltered comparator.
Actual module identity, bus layout, state/editor lifecycle, host latency, output energy, architecture, seal, and source-tree non-mutation.
